tools.name: efm_list_agent_classes
tools.description:
List every agent class EFM manages (name, description, and the agent
            manifest(s) each class is bound to). An agent class groups MiNiFi agents
            that share one flow — the top of the edge hierarchy.

tools.name: efm_get_agent_class
tools.description:
Detail for one agent class: its manifest ids, monitoring config, and
            any Designer flow association. Start here to resolve a class to its manifest.

tools.name: efm_list_agents
tools.description:
List enrolled MiNiFi agents with their last-heartbeat timestamp
            (status/firstSeen/lastSeen) — the primary online/offline signal. Pass
            agent_class to filter to one class; omit it for every agent.

tools.name: efm_get_agent
tools.description:
Full record for one agent: its class, device/host, manifest hash, and
            heartbeat/status detail. Use to confirm which manifest an agent actually reports.

tools.name: efm_get_class_monitor
tools.description:
Per-class health view: current flow version, agent counts
            (online / missing), health status, and connection metrics. The fastest
            answer to "is this class healthy and how many agents are up?".

tools.name: efm_get_manifest
tools.description:
The agent manifest(s) for a class: the processor, controller-service,
            and reporting-task types that class can run. This is what tells you whether
            a flow you want to build is even deployable to that class's agents.

tools.name: efm_get_manifest_by_id
tools.description:
One agent manifest by its id (as listed on an agent class or agent record).
            Returns the full component-type catalog with property descriptors.

tools.name: efm_list_flows
tools.description:
One summary per agent class: `identifier` (the flowId), `agentClass`, and
            `rootProcessGroupIdentifier`. This is how you map a class to the flowId that
            efm_get_flow / efm_validate_flow take.

tools.name: efm_get_flow
tools.description:
The full live Designer flow document for a flowId: process groups,
            processors, connections, controller services, and parameters. Ground truth
            for what an agent class is running — read this before reasoning about a flow.

tools.name: efm_validate_flow
tools.description:
Validation results for a flow — the same check EFM runs before a publish.
            Surfaces invalid/misconfigured components without changing anything.

tools.name: efm_list_resources
tools.description:
All resources in EFM's resource manager (assets and extension bundles),
            with names, types, and SHA-512 digests — the files EFM can push to agents.

tools.name: efm_list_class_resources
tools.description:
Resources currently assigned to one agent class — the assets/extensions
            EFM syncs to every agent in that class on its next heartbeat.
